title: Callback Period and Transfer Terms across HomeCare Programs
content:
The callback period of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty — the calendar days after a repair is completed within which a recurrence of the same item is reopened on the original claim — and the terms on which the remaining coverage passes to a subsequent owner of the home differ by HomeCare program as follows.

| Program | Callback period (calendar days after completion) | Remaining coverage transfers to a subsequent owner | Transfer fee paid by the subsequent owner | Registration period (calendar days after the subsequent owner's deed date) | Transfer restarts a coverage period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 30 | Yes | USD 150.00 | 30 | No |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 30 | Yes | USD 150.00 | 30 | No |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 45 | Yes | USD 125.00 | 45 | No |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 60 | Yes | USD 100.00 | 45 | No |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 60 | Yes | USD 75.00 | 60 | No |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 90 | Yes | USD 0.00 | 60 | No |

**Reading the rider.**
- Every program allows the remaining coverage to transfer, and in no program does a transfer restart any coverage period.
- A HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve transfer carries a fee of USD 0.00.
- Hypothetical illustration: under HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus, a subsequent owner has 45 calendar days after the deed date to register and pays a transfer fee of USD 125.00, and a recurrence of a repaired item can be reopened on the original claim for 45 calendar days after the repair was completed.
